options: the product formation rate is independent of reactant concentration.

The speed of the pulse will be constant along the length of the rope.
questions.solution:
Tension at a section x distance from free end is

T=mg=μ·x·g

where, μ= mass per unit length of rope. 

Wave speed over the rope is given by 

v=Tμ=μ·x·gμ=g·x

⇒v2=gx

Comparing above equation with 

v2-u2=2as, we get

⇒v2=2ax=gx

⇒ Acceleration, a=g2

Now, if t= time for wave pulse to cover a distance x,

then from 

s=ut+12at2,

we have 

x=12×g2×t2

or t=2xg

⇒t∝x

or time to travel complete length of rope t∝L.
